recipes.name: Protein-Packed Lentil & Quinoa Salad
instructions: Cook the quinoa according to the package instructions.
Soak the edamame in hot water while working through the remaining steps.
Mix all of the dressing ingredients in a bowl until creamy.
Drain the edamame and add all of the salad ingredients to a large bowl and toss to combine.
Mix in the salad dressing when ready to serve, toss to combine, and enjoy!

page_recipe_notes: Notes † White miso, also called "Shiro Miso," is fermented for less time than red miso, which gives it a milder, sweeter flavour. If substituting red miso, use a smaller amount and adjust to taste, as red miso is saltier and stronger.
Storage Store in an airtight container in the fridge for up to 3 days. Store the sauce separately and combine only when ready to serve.
